chapter_plans.title: The Glass Meridian Shattered
chapter_plans.one_line_summary: Lin Wei and Adrian dismantle the Aurelian core from Adrian's compromised private office, transforming their contract into a genuine, desperate alliance forged in the heat of their final confrontation.
beat_summary: The breach: following the message from Adrian's security chief, Lin Wei and Adrian storm his private office and discover the hidden Aurelian core terminal running behind the wall-safe, while the intruder has already triggered a purge countdown.

The revelation: Lin Wei bypasses the final biometric locks and uncovers the medical records proving her mother survived the illegal Aurelian biotech trials, while Adrian realizes his former board authorization unknowingly enabled the system that buried those victims.

The emotional collision: Lin Wei nearly breaks under the truth that Adrian once stood inside the machine that destroyed her family, and Adrian chooses full confession over defense, handing her the authority to decide whether they expose everything together.

The climax: they leak the Aurelian trial archive, burn Adrian's executive protections, force a public disclosure, and use the released medical protocol to stabilize Lin Wei's mother through the critical phase.

The intimacy: in the sealed private vault behind Adrian's office, the aftershock of betrayal, survival, and chosen trust erupts into an explicit 18+ encounter that takes up roughly 40% of the chapter and cements the contract marriage as a real alliance.
chapter_plans.opens_with: Adrian kicked in the hidden panel behind his own office wall-safe just as the purge timer hit sixty seconds, and Lin Wei saw a woman's gloved hand vanish from the live security feed beside her mother's hospital bed.
chapter_plans.cliffhanger: After the leak goes public and Lin Wei's mother survives the critical night, Lin Wei finds a fresh vial taped beneath the hospital bedside drawer, labeled with her own childhood blood code and a Meridian message: 'Your mother was only the first generation.'
